comment.body:
Thanks for the screenshot and the diagnostic report already attached. A Command Palette maintainer identified one specific setting that can override the position shown in the main Dock configuration.

Please open Command Palette Settings > Dock, check the multi-monitor Dock option, and reply with:

1. Whether that option is enabled and which position it specifies.
2. Whether disabling the override makes the Dock appear at the configured top position.
3. If it still stays at the bottom, upload a focused screenshot of that multi-monitor setting. No new `/bugreport` is needed for this configuration check unless the maintainer asks for one.

This will distinguish a configuration override from a Dock positioning defect.
